PrometheusInstanceStoreConfig.description_en: The storage configuration of the Prometheus instance

parallelCountPerHost.description_en: The concurrency per host. Valid values: 1 to 8. Default value: 2
parallelCountPerHost.description_zh: 单机并发数，未传默认 2，范围 1~8
parallelCountPerHost.title: 单机并发数，未传默认 2，范围 1~8

parallelEnable.descriptionEn: Whether parallel query is enabled. Treated as false when absent.
parallelEnable.description_en: Specifies whether to enable parallel query. If not returned, the value is considered false
parallelEnable.description_zh: 是否开启查询并行。未返回时视为 false
parallelEnable.title: 查询并行开关

parallelMode.description_en: The parallel query mode. Valid values: auto, static. Default value: auto
parallelMode.description_zh: 查询并行模式：auto | static，未传默认 auto
parallelMode.title: 查询并行模式：auto | static，未传默认 auto

queryCacheEnable.descriptionEn: Whether the query cache is enabled. Treated as false when absent.
queryCacheEnable.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the query cache. If not returned, the value is considered false
queryCacheEnable.description_zh: 是否开启查询缓存。未返回时视为 false
queryCacheEnable.title: 查询缓存开关

totalParallelCount.description_en: The global concurrency. Valid values: 2 to 64. Default value: 8
totalParallelCount.description_zh: 全局并发数，未传默认 8，范围 2~64
totalParallelCount.title: 全局并发数，未传默认 8，范围 2~64

PrometheusInstanceStoreConfig.title: Prometheus实例的存储配置

description_en: Retrieves or creates a shared Prometheus instance for a workspace
name: EnsureSharedPrometheusInstance

parameters.help_en: The share scope. Currently, only Workspace is supported, which indicates the shared Prometheus instance for the workspace in the requested region. Workspaces in the same region share the same instance, and no additional instances are created. Policy and Environment are not currently supported
parameters.help_zh: 共享范围。当前仅支持 Workspace，表示该 Workspace 在请求地域的共享 Prometheus 实例。同一 Workspace 的 Region 共享使用同一实例，不另建。Policy、Environment 暂不支持
parameters.name: share_scope

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace. If the workspace does not exist, a 404 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。工作空间不存在时返回 404
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned information. zh indicates Chinese, and en indicates English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回信息的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文。默认 zh
parameters.name: aliyun_lang

schema.description_en: The details of the shared Prometheus instance and whether a new instance is created in this call
schema.description_zh: 共享 Prometheus 实例详情，以及本次调用是否新创建了实例

created.description_en: Indicates whether a new instance is created by this call. The value is false if an existing instance is found
created.description_zh: 本次调用是否新创建了实例。找到已有实例时为 false

prometheusInstance.description_en: The details of the shared Prometheus instance. The fields are the same as the prometheusInstance field in GetPrometheusInstance
prometheusInstance.description_zh: 共享 Prometheus 实例详情，字段与 GetPrometheusInstance 的 prometheusInstance 一致

accessType.description_en: The access permissions of the instance. Valid values: readWrite, readOnly, and httpReadOnly
accessType.description_zh: 实例访问权限。取值 readWrite、readOnly、httpReadOnly

archiveDuration.description_en: The number of days for automatic archive retention after the storage expires. A value of 0 indicates no archiving, and 3650 indicates permanent retention
archiveDuration.description_zh: 存储到期后自动归档保存的天数。0 表示不归档，3650 表示永久保存

authFreeReadPolicy.description_en: The IP address whitelist policy that allows access to the authentication-free read endpoint
authFreeReadPolicy.description_zh: 读免密地址允许访问的 IP 白名单策略

authFreeWritePolicy.description_en: The IP address whitelist policy that allows access to the authentication-free write endpoint
authFreeWritePolicy.description_zh: 写免密地址允许访问的 IP 白名单策略

authToken.description_en: The authentication token of the instance

createTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time is displayed in UTC+0 in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
createTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间，UTC+0，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

enableAuthFreeRead.description_en: Indicates whether authentication-free read is enabled

enableAuthFreeWrite.description_en: Indicates whether authentication-free write is enabled

enableAuthToken.description_en: Indicates whether authentication token-based authentication is enabled
enableAuthToken.description_zh: 是否开启 AuthToken 认证

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the extended information

extraInfo.description_en: The extended information. This field is returned only for console requests
extraInfo.description_zh: 扩展信息。仅控制台请求返回

folderUrl.description_en: The URL of the dashboard associated with the instance
folderUrl.description_zh: 实例关联的可视化大盘地址

grafanaInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the bound managed Grafana instance
grafanaInstanceId.description_zh: 绑定的托管 Grafana 实例 ID

grafanaInstanceName.description_en: The name of the bound managed Grafana instance
grafanaInstanceName.description_zh: 绑定的托管 Grafana 实例名称

httpApiInterUrl.description_en: The public endpoint of the Prometheus HTTP API
httpApiInterUrl.description_zh: Prometheus HTTP API 的公网地址

httpApiInternalUrl.description_en: The internal endpoint of the Prometheus HTTP API
httpApiInternalUrl.description_zh: Prometheus HTTP API 的内部地址

httpApiIntraUrl.description_en: The internal network endpoint of the Prometheus HTTP API
httpApiIntraUrl.description_zh: Prometheus HTTP API 的内网地址

instanceType.description_en: The instance type. For a shared instance, the value is remote-write, which indicates Prometheus for Remote Write
instanceType.description_zh: 实例类型。共享实例为 remote-write，表示 Prometheus for Remote Write

paymentType.description_en: The billing method. POSTPAY indicates pay-as-you-go billing based on the number of reported metrics, and POSTPAY_GB indicates pay-as-you-go billing based on the volume of written metrics
paymentType.description_zh: 计费方式。POSTPAY 表示按指标上报量后付费，POSTPAY_GB 表示按指标写入量后付费

paymentTypeUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the billing method of the instance was last modified. The time is in UTC+0 and formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
paymentTypeUpdateTime.description_zh: 实例计费方式最近一次修改时间，UTC+0，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

product.description_en: The product to which the instance belongs. Valid values: arms and cms
product.description_zh: 实例归属的产品，取值为 arms 或 cms

prometheusInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Prometheus instance

prometheusInstanceName.description_en: The name of the Prometheus instance. For a workspace shared instance, the name is generated by the server in the RegionShare:{workspace}:{regionId} format
prometheusInstanceName.description_zh: Prometheus 实例名称。Workspace 共享实例由服务端生成为 RegionShare:{workspace}:{regionId}

pushGatewayIntraUrl.description_en: The internal network endpoint of Pushgateway

regionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides

remoteReadInterUrl.description_en: The public endpoint of Remote Read

remoteReadInternalUrl.description_en: The internal endpoint of Remote Read

remoteReadIntraUrl.description_en: The internal network endpoint of Remote Read

remoteWriteInterUrl.description_en: The public endpoint of Remote Write

remoteWriteInternalUrl.description_en: The internal endpoint of Remote Write

remoteWriteIntraUrl.description_en: The internal network endpoint of Remote Write

resourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs

resourceType.description_en: The resource type. The value is fixed as PrometheusInstance

status.description_en: The backend data storage status, such as Running
status.description_zh: 后端数据存储状态，例如 Running

storageDuration.description_en: The metric storage duration in days
storageDuration.description_zh: 指标存储时长，单位为天

storeConfig.description_en: The Prometheus query cache and parallel query configurations
storeConfig.description_zh: Prometheus 查询缓存和并行查询配置

supportAuthTypes.description_en: The list of authentication and authorization types supported by the instance
supportAuthTypes.description_zh: 实例支持的认证鉴权类型列表

items.description_en: An authentication and authorization type supported by the instance. Valid values: BasicAuth, AuthFree, and AuthToken
items.description_zh: 实例支持的一种认证鉴权类型。取值 BasicAuth、AuthFree、AuthToken

tags.description_en: The instance tags. A workspace shared instance includes the system tag acs:cms:shareScope
tags.description_zh: 实例标签。Workspace 共享实例包含系统标签 acs:cms:shareScope

key.description_en: The key of the instance tag

value.description_en: The value of the instance tag

userId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the instance belongs
userId.description_zh: 实例所属阿里云账号 ID

version.description_en: The version of the instance, such as V2

workspace.description_en: The name of the workspace to which the instance belongs
workspace.description_zh: 实例所属工作空间名称

schema.title_en: 获取或创建共享Prometheus实例的响应
schema.title_zh: 获取或创建共享Prometheus实例的响应
